request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only the colour of the leather: the orange crossed chest straps, the loincloth and the satchel become a warm mid-brown saddle leather, the brown of a chestnut, with a dark brown shadow tone; clearly brown, not orange and not red. Do not touch his skin, face or ears. Keep everything else exactly the same: the rusted iron pot helmet and goggles, the olive green skin, the bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, gloves, boots, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
